evidence.interpretation: ridge along X (slopes seen on the sides along it, the gable end across it); pitch 37.3° from a 3.13 m rise over half of 8.23 m; no gable-end view gives the wall's corner under the roof: the roofs' lowest drawn edge (2.38 m, the eaves' edge out on the overhang) is taken as the wall's top under the roof, a lower bound; agreed again after the last change: 37.3° over the 8.23 m span it now has against 30° (the pitch the structure read states for the main roof): the ridge at 5.83 m is this roof's own (a view across it draws the roof narrowing to it; 5.79 m is stated for the house's top from outside the silhouettes) and its eaves were only a lower bound (2.33 m, the lowest edge drawn there) — the eaves follow from the ridge: 3.45 m, the walls under them to 3.16 m
